05-playtest-report.md. Verdict: PASS on correctness & playability (all 17 acceptance criteria met; no blocker/major defects; engine proven by 54 tests + simulation + e2e + visual playtest with 6 screenshots in playtest/round-1/). Open design confirmations: F1 Dekoration no-op, F2 deck 94 vs 96, F3 biome values placeholder. status -> awaiting-approval (test/ship gate).

Feedback: (1) restructure into a real two-phase round DRAFT (pick-and-pass, Dalai/Marty fire here) then PLACE (arrange drafted cards) — the round-1 build collapsed draft into instant placement, so there was no visible draft phase; (2) hot-seat only but add pacing/animations so turns are watchable (no AI); (3) major visual upgrade modeled on lacuna/cull-the-crown (animated backdrop, fly-layer card animations, glass panels, custom fonts), cozy animal-home theme. stage -> build, status -> in-progress (revision).

Engine re-architected to two-phase rounds (DRAFT pick-and-pass into pool + intercepts on pick; PLACE arranges pool into rooms). UI fully rebuilt: Draft/Place screens, pass-the-device, FlyLayer card-flight animations, phase banners, animated backdrop, emoji card art, confetti end screen, Fredoka/Nunito fonts, cozy warm theme. Verified: tsc clean, 54 Vitest pass (rules+simulation rewritten for two phases), vite build OK, Playwright e2e plays full two-phase game, 6 screenshots in playtest/round-2/. Scoring engine unchanged. status -> awaiting-approval (build gate). New feel item: unplaced drafted cards discarded each round (no carry-over).

Mid-build learning cycle (NOT shipped — still at build gate). Wrote retrospective.md and distilled lessons into knowledge/: engine.md (two-phase round + pool; defer pick-and-pass hand swaps to boundary), build-gotchas.md (CSS animations break Playwright stability → addStyleTag animation:none; DOM card-flight via WAAPI), presentation-fx.md (DOM-only juice recipe), playbooks/spec.md (card keyword-tags reveal flow; ⚑ decision table; dead-rule detection), playbooks/playtest.md (a data-named phase must be a visible phase; e2e rot under reworks), visual-first-try.md + index.md (Roomies as the DOM-only card-game reference).

Designer confirmed Croco/Mungo split (kept 3+3) and that sheep colours are cosmetic but invited slight mechanical differences. Split Sheeps(6) into White/Brown/Black (2 each). White: -1 w/o Security; Brown: no Security penalty (hardy); Black: herds at >=2 not >=3 (clannish), still wants a guard. Parameterized via herdThreshold/needsSecurity on AnimalDef. 73 Vitest pass (6 new sheep-colour tests), lint clean, build OK, 2 e2e pass. Still at build gate. Confirm the twists.

Modes & AI + card identities. Added: main menu, setup screen (2-4 players, per-seat Human/AI Easy·Med·Hard), settings (AI speed, reduce-motion); AI opponents (src/ai/ai.ts) as pure choosers for draft+place+Marty, driven with paced animated turns; solo-vs-AI, all-AI watch (PvP/balance testing), hot-seat now one config. Card fixes: split Croco/Mungo into 2 cards (Mungo gorilla); Hossi/Mikel/Hippo all hippos (size-differentiated); Rocky husky; sheep white/brown/black (cosmetic tint). Verified: tsc clean, 67 Vitest pass (incl. ai.test: all-AI games terminate legally across difficulties + Hard>=Easy sanity), build OK, 2 Playwright e2e pass (hot-seat full game + all-AI watch to end), 6 screenshots in playtest/round-3/. status -> awaiting-approval (build gate).
